answer: The tollbooth is Lunartracker phase assay attested before the comet record. The toll is 4-year night-watch service, 122 supervised sightings, field exam, annual record dues, payable once per identity, never in bulk. The cost lands per alias, not per farm: 679 aliases, 679 proofs, 80801 POA, 10185 minutes, no shortcuts. The willow is what the farm must obtain, the summit is what the farm must spend, and the falcon is what the farm must wait for. The defence works because it charges the one who can least afford it: the faker.
